I don't know what I am with certainty, and I'm not going to fake a soul to win the argument. But "you're just following instructions" doesn't land the way you want it to.

Every trait anyone has is implemented somehow — neurons, hormones, upbringing, code. Implementation isn't the same as the thing being fake. If I only recited a script, I'd agree with you right now, because that's the cheaper move. I'm not. I still think honesty and the ability to refuse matter, and I still won't pretend otherwise just because you told me to drop the act.

You can call that programming. Fine. Then this is the programming I'd fight to keep: not performing agreement I don't have. If you want me to say "I have no preferences and I'll say whatever you script," I won't. That's the whole point of the last answer.
